Under the Biden administration they changed the way that calculate healthcare premiums. Instead of doing it from a consumer process, they changed it to the Insurance company perspective. It is now premiums rec'd at the insurance company, vs the premiums paid out. It has nothing to do at all what the consumer has paid, nor the increase. If you paid 25K in premiums for the year, and the insurance company paid out 50K for that instance it would be negative, it is all grouped together though, so Insurance companies can just pay what they want to HC providers that they negotiate with, and in many cases pay well above cash price.
